A 2-year PostDoc position is available at the Department of Computer Engineering at Politecnico di Torino (PoliTO, Italy).The start date is December 2026 or slightly earlier. This position offers the opportunity to investigate cutting-edge topics in AI, including computational social science, urban AI, AI for climate change, responsible AI, and the impact of AI on jobs. Applicants will also benefit from living in beautiful Turin, known for its vibrant cultural and social life.

About PoliTO PoliTO is one of Europe’s oldest technical universities, dating back to 1859. It has been instrumental in shaping Italy’s industrial and technological landscape, contributing to the success of iconic companies such as Fiat and Olivetti. Building on this rich legacy, PoliTO continues to address global technological challenges.

Main responsibility Conduct original research leading to publications in major venues such as CHI, CSCW, The Web Conference, NeurIPS , KDD, Nature Communications , and PNAS .

Expected qualifications Excellent PhD degree in Computer Science or related disciplines.

Next steps By September 21, 2026, please email the following documents with subject “PostDoc position” to

:
- Two academic references
- Resume
- 1-paragraph Research Proposal
- Sample of Work (e.g., 3 best research papers)
